title: Attention Implementation + Visualization
description: Implement scaled dot-product and multi-head attention from scratch in PyTorch, verify them numerically against a reference, and build an attention-map visualizer over real text sequences that explains what the model attends to.
learningObjectives: Implement causal and non-causal attention from first principles
Verify numerical equivalence with PyTorch reference ops
Render interpretable attention maps over token sequences
Explain multi-head behaviour with concrete examples

milestones.title: Scaled dot-product attention
milestones.objective: Implement Q/K/V attention with masking; verify against torch.nn.functional equivalents.
milestones.expectedOutput: Tests pass to 1e-5 on seeded inputs.

milestones.title: Multi-head attention
milestones.objective: Implement heads, projections, and output combining; verify against the reference implementation.

milestones.title: Causal variants
milestones.objective: Add causal masking and padding handling; test with variable-length sequences.
milestones.expectedOutput: Correct masked outputs on ragged batches.

milestones.title: Attention maps
milestones.objective: Visualize attention matrices for at least three example sentences; annotate heads that track syntax or coreference.
milestones.expectedOutput: Rendered maps with commentary in the report.

categories.minimumExpectation: Equivalence tests pass with stated tolerances
Maps for three examples with captions
categories.excellentExpectation: Analysis of head behaviour groups with limitations noted

categories.minimumExpectation: README covers the math and usage
categories.excellentExpectation: Step-by-step walkthrough of one forward pass

constraints: No copying reference internals; re-derive formulas
hints: Use attention-as-explanation with humility: note that attention weights are not proven causal explanations
